<algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Find the closest unclustered point to the current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n// Returns -1 if no such point exists\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    \n    // Try each unclustered point as a candidate\n    for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n        // Skip if already clustered or already in this cluster\n        if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n        \n        // Calculate the maximum distance from candidate to all cluster members\n        double max_dist = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n            max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n        }\n        \n        // If adding this point keeps diameter below threshold and is better than current best\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {\n            min_diameter = max_dist;\n            closest_point = candidate;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return closest_point;\n}\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * Seed point s is evaluated by rank s % size. Each rank keeps a\n// priority queue of the candidate-cluster sizes of its own seeds, and one\n// MPI_Allreduce(MPI_MAXLOC) per round picks the globally largest candidate\n// cluster (lowest seed index on ties), exactly as the sequential algorithm does.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <numeric>\n#include <queue>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_GRID_CELLS_PER_AXIS = 1024.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Uniform grid over the points. Cells are at least as wide as the threshold,\n// so every point within the threshold of p lies in the 3x3 block of cells\n// around p. Callers still apply the exact distance test.\nclass PointGrid {\n  public:\n    PointGrid(const std::vector<Point>& points, const double threshold) {\n        min_x_ = points[0].x;\n        min_y_ = points[0].y;\n        double max_x = min_x_;\n        double max_y = min_y_;\n        for (const Point& p : points) {\n            min_x_ = std::min(min_x_, p.x);\n            min_y_ = std::min(min_y_, p.y);\n            max_x = std::max(max_x, p.x);\n            max_y = std::max(max_y, p.y);\n        }\n\n        // Slightly widened cells absorb rounding in the cell index; the cap on\n        // cells per axis keeps the grid small for very small thresholds.\n        const double extent = std::max(max_x - min_x_, max_y - min_y_);\n        cell_ = std::max(threshold * 1.0001, extent / MAX_GRID_CELLS_PER_AXIS);\n        nx_ = static_cast<int>((max_x - min_x_) / cell_) + 1;\n        ny_ = static_cast<int>((max_y - min_y_) / cell_) + 1;\n\n        // Counting sort of point indices by cell (CSR layout)\n        start_.assign(static_cast<size_t>(nx_) * ny_ + 1, 0);\n        for (const Point& p : points) {\n            ++start_[cellOf(p) + 1];\n        }\n        std::partial_sum(start_.begin(), start_.end(), start_.begin());\n\n        std::vector<int> fill(start_.begin(), start_.end() - 1);\n        items_.resize(points.size());\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < points.size(); ++i) {\n            items_[fill[cellOf(points[i])]++] = static_cast<int>(i);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Calls visit(index) for every point in the 3x3 cell block around p\n    template <typename Visit>\n    void forEachNear(const Point& p, Visit&& visit) const {\n        const int cx = cellX(p.x);\n        const int cy = cellY(p.y);\n        for (int y = std::max(cy - 1, 0); y <= std::min(cy + 1, ny_ - 1); ++y) {\n            for (int x = std::max(cx - 1, 0); x <= std::min(cx + 1, nx_ - 1); ++x) {\n                const int cell = y * nx_ + x;\n                for (int k = start_[cell]; k < start_[cell + 1]; ++k) {\n                    visit(items_[k]);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n  private:\n    int cellX(const double x) const {\n        return std::min(nx_ - 1, static_cast<int>((x - min_x_) / cell_));\n    }\n    int cellY(const double y) const {\n        return std::min(ny_ - 1, static_cast<int>((y - min_y_) / cell_));\n    }\n    int cellOf(const Point& p) const {\n        return cellY(p.y) * nx_ + cellX(p.x);\n    }\n\n    double min_x_ = 0.0, min_y_ = 0.0, cell_ = 1.0;\n    int nx_ = 1, ny_ = 1;\n    std::vector<int> start_;\n    std::vector<int> items_;\n};\n\n// Grows the candidate cluster of a seed point. Only unclustered points within\n// the threshold of the seed can ever join, so the search is restricted to them.\n// Each candidate's maximum distance to the cluster is maintained incrementally,\n// and candidates that reach the threshold are dropped for good.\nclass CandidateGrower {\n  public:\n    CandidateGrower(const std::vector<Point>& points, const PointGrid& grid,\n                    const double threshold, const std::vector<char>& clustered)\n        : points_(points), grid_(grid), threshold_(threshold), clustered_(clustered) {}\n\n    // Writes the members (seed first, then in insertion order) and returns their count\n    int grow(const int seed, std::vector<int>& members) {\n        members.assign(1, seed);\n        active_.clear();\n\n        grid_.forEachNear(points_[seed], [&](int candidate) {\n            if (candidate == seed || clustered_[candidate]) return;\n            const double dist = distance(points_[candidate], points_[seed]);\n            if (dist < threshold_) {\n                active_.push_back({candidate, dist});\n            }\n        });\n        // Ascending index order makes ties resolve to the lowest index\n        std::sort(active_.begin(), active_.end(),\n                  [](const Candidate& a, const Candidate& b) { return a.index < b.index; });\n\n        while (!active_.empty()) {\n            size_t best = 0;\n            for (size_t i = 1; i < active_.size(); ++i) {\n                if (active_[i].max_dist < active_[best].max_dist) best = i;\n            }\n            const int chosen = active_[best].index;\n            members.push_back(chosen);\n            active_.erase(active_.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(best));\n\n            size_t kept = 0;\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < active_.size(); ++i) {\n                Candidate cand = active_[i];\n                cand.max_dist = std::max(cand.max_dist,\n active_.resize(kept);\n        }\n\n        return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n    }\n\n  private:\n    struct Candidate {\n        int index;\n        double max_dist;\n    };\n\n    const of a seed, tagged with the seed version it was computed at\nstruct SeedEntry {\n    int cardinality;\n    int seed;\n    int version;\n};\n\n// Max-heap order: larger cluster first, lower seed index a.seed > b.seed;\n    }\n};\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm, distributed over MPI ranks.\n// Every rank returns the same clusters.\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  const int rank, const int size) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> version(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> stamp(N, -1);\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    const PointGrid grid(points, threshold);\n    CandidateGrower grower(points, grid, threshold, clustered);\n\n    std::priority_queue<SeedEntry, std::vector<SeedEntry>, SeedOrder> heap;\n    std::vector<int> scratch;\n\n    // Recompute the candidate cluster of an owned seed and queue its size\n    auto refresh = [&](const int seed) {\n        ++version[seed];\n        heap.push({grower.grow(seed, scratch), seed, version[seed]});\n    };\n\n    for (int s = rank; s < N; s += size) {\n        refresh(s);\n    }\n\n    int remaining = N;\n    std::vector<int> affected;\n    for (int round = 0; remaining > 0; ++round) {\n        // Best owned seed: discard stale heap entries until the top is current\n        int local[2] = {-1, N};  // {cardinality, seed}\n        while (!heap.empty()) {\n            const SeedEntry top = heap.top();\n            if (!clustered[top.seed] && top.version == version[top.seed]) {\n                local[0] = top.cardinality;\n                local[1] = top.seed;\n                break;\n            }\n            heap.pop();\n        }\n\n        int global[2];\n        MPI_Allreduce(local, global, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        const int max_cardinality = global[0];\n        const int best_seed = global[1];\n\n        // No cluster can be formed (matches the sequential early exit)\n        if (best_seed < 0 || max_cardinality <= 0) break;\n\n        // Every rank regrows the winning cluster; the result is identical everywhere\n        clusters.emplace_back();\n        Cluster& cluster = clusters.back();\n        cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n        grower.grow(best_seed, cluster.members);\n\n        for (int p : cluster.members) {\n            clustered[p] = 1;\n        }\n        remaining -= static_cast<int>(cluster.members.size());\n\n        // Owned seeds whose candidate pool contained a newly clustered point\n        // must be recomputed; all other cached sizes remain valid\n        affected.clear();\n        for (int p : cluster.members) {\n            grid.forEachNear(points[p], [&](int q) {\n                if (q % size != rank || clustered[q] || stamp[q] == round) return;\n                if (distance(points[q], points[p]) < threshold) {\n                    stamp[q] = round;\n                    affected.push_back(q);\n                }\n            });\n        }\n        for (int q : affected) {\n            refresh(q);\n        }\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties.\n// Diameters are computed in parallel and all ranks reach the same verdict;\n// only rank 0 prints.\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int rank, const int size) {\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    if (root) printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Check diameter (max distance between any two points) of owned clusters\n    std::vector<double> diameters(clusters.size(), 0.0);\n    for (size_t c = static_cast<size_t>(rank); c < clusters.size();\n         c += static_cast<size_t>(size)) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]],\n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        diameters[c] = max_diameter;\n    }\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, diameters.data(), static_cast<int>(diameters.size()),\n                  MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        const double max_diameter = diameters[c];\n\n        if (root && c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            if (root) printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\",\n                             c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                if (root) printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                                 member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n               points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n    }\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable const int rank, const int size) {\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments (identical on every rank)\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        if (root) {\n            printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\",\n                   num_points, threshold);\n        }\n        return 1;\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n        printf(\"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // Generate synthetic data (deterministic, so every rank builds the same set)\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n\n    // Perform QT clustering\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double cluster_start = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold, rank, size);\n\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double cluster_end = MPI_Wtime();\n    const long cluster_ms = static_cast<long>((cluster_end - cluster_start) * 1000.0);\n\n    // Calculate statistics and performance metrics\n    int total_clustered = 0;\n    int max_cluster_size = 0;\n\n    for Seed point s is evaluated by rank s % size. Each rank keeps a\n// priority queue of the candidate-cluster sizes of its own seeds, and one\n// MPI_Allreduce(MPI_MAXLOC) per round picks the globally largest candidate\n// cluster (lowest seed index on ties), exactly as the sequential algorithm does.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <numeric>\n#include <queue>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_GRID_CELLS_PER_AXIS = 1024.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Uniform grid over the points. Cells are at least as wide as the threshold,\n// so every point within the threshold of p lies in the 3x3 block of cells\n// around p. Callers still apply the exact distance test.\nclass PointGrid {\n  public:\n    PointGrid(const std::vector<Point>& points, const double threshold) {\n        min_x_ = points[0].x;\n        min_y_ = points[0].y;\n        double max_x = min_x_;\n        double max_y = min_y_;\n        for (const Point& p : points) {\n            min_x_ = std::min(min_x_, p.x);\n            min_y_ = std::min(min_y_, p.y);\n            max_x = std::max(max_x, p.x);\n            max_y = std::max(max_y, p.y);\n        }\n\n        // Slightly widened cells absorb rounding in the cell index; the cap on\n        // cells per axis keeps the grid small for very small thresholds.\n        const double extent = std::max(max_x - min_x_, max_y - min_y_);\n        cell_ = std::max(threshold * 1.0001, extent / MAX_GRID_CELLS_PER_AXIS);\n        nx_ = static_cast<int>((max_x - min_x_) / cell_) + 1;\n        ny_ = static_cast<int>((max_y - min_y_) / cell_) + 1;\n\n        // Counting sort of point indices by cell (CSR layout)\n        start_.assign(static_cast<size_t>(nx_) * ny_ + 1, 0);\n        for (const Point& p : points) {\n            ++start_[cellOf(p) + 1];\n        }\n        std::partial_sum(start_.begin(), start_.end(), start_.begin());\n\n        std::vector<int> fill(start_.begin(), start_.end() - 1);\n        items_.resize(points.size());\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < points.size(); ++i) {\n            items_[fill[cellOf(points[i])]++] = static_cast<int>(i);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Calls visit(index) for every point in the 3x3 cell block around p\n    template <typename Visit>\n    void forEachNear(const Point& p, Visit&& visit) const {\n        const int cx = cellX(p.x);\n        const int cy = cellY(p.y);\n        for (int y = std::max(cy - 1, 0); y <= std::min(cy + 1, ny_ - 1); ++y) {\n            for (int x = std::max(cx - 1, 0); x <= std::min(cx + 1, nx_ - 1); ++x) {\n                const int cell = y * nx_ + x;\n                for (int k = start_[cell]; k < start_[cell + 1]; ++k) {\n                    visit(items_[k]);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n  private:\n    int cellX(const double x) const {\n        return std::min(nx_ - 1, static_cast<int>((x - min_x_) / cell_));\n    }\n    int cellY(const double y) const {\n        return std::min(ny_ - 1, static_cast<int>((y - min_y_) / cell_));\n    }\n    int cellOf(const Point& p) const {\n        return cellY(p.y) * nx_ + cellX(p.x);\n    }\n\n    double min_x_ = 0.0, min_y_ = 0.0, cell_ = 1.0;\n    int nx_ = 1, ny_ = 1;\n    std::vector<int> start_;\n    std::vector<int> items_;\n};\n\n// Grows the candidate cluster of a seed point. Only unclustered points within\n// the threshold of the seed can ever join, so the search is restricted to them.\n// Each candidate's maximum distance to the cluster is maintained incrementally,\n// and candidates that reach the threshold are dropped for good.\nclass CandidateGrower {\n  public:\n    CandidateGrower(const std::vector<Point>& points, const PointGrid& grid,\n                    const double threshold, const std::vector<char>& clustered)\n        : points_(points), grid_(grid), threshold_(threshold), clustered_(clustered) {}\n\n    // Writes the members (seed first, then in insertion order) and returns their count\n    int grow(const int seed, std::vector<int>& members) {\n        members.assign(1, seed);\n        active_.clear();\n\n        grid_.forEachNear(points_[seed], [&](int candidate) {\n            if (candidate == seed || clustered_[candidate]) return;\n            const double dist = distance(points_[candidate], points_[seed]);\n            if (dist < threshold_) {\n                active_.push_back({candidate, dist});\n            }\n        });\n        // Ascending index order makes ties resolve to the lowest index\n        std::sort(active_.begin(), active_.end(),\n                  [](const Candidate& a, const Candidate& b) { return a.index < b.index; });\n\n        while (!active_.empty()) {\n            size_t best = 0;\n            for (size_t i = 1; i < active_.size(); ++i) {\n                if (active_[i].max_dist < active_[best].max_dist) best = i;\n            }\n            const int chosen = active_[best].index;\n            members.push_back(chosen);\n            active_.erase(active_.begin() + static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(best));\n\n            size_t kept = 0;\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < active_.size(); ++i) {\n                Candidate cand = active_[i];\n                cand.max_dist = std::max(cand.max_dist,\n                                         distance(points_[cand.index], points_[chosen]));\n                if (cand.max_dist < threshold_) {\n                    active_[kept++] = cand;\n                }\n            }\n            active_.resize(kept);\n        }\n\n        return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n    }\n\n  private:\n    struct Candidate {\n        int index;\n        double max_dist;\n    };\n\n    const std::vector<Point>& points_;\n    const PointGrid& grid_;\n    const double threshold_;\n    const std::vector<char>& clustered_;\n    std::vector<Candidate> active_;\n};\n\n// Candidate-cluster size of a seed, tagged with the seed version it was computed at\nstruct SeedEntry {\n    int cardinality;\n    int seed;\n    int version;\n};\n\n// Max-heap order: larger cluster first, lower seed index on ties\nstruct SeedOrder {\n    bool operator()(const SeedEntry& a, const SeedEntry& b) const {\n        if (a.cardinality != b.cardinality) return a.cardinality < b.cardinality;\n        return a.seed > b.seed;\n    }\n};\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm, distributed over MPI ranks.\n// Every rank returns the same clusters.\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold,\n                                  const int rank, const int size) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> version(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> stamp(N, -1);\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    const PointGrid grid(points, threshold);\n    CandidateGrower grower(points, grid, threshold, clustered);\n\n    std::priority_queue<SeedEntry, std::vector<SeedEntry>, SeedOrder> heap;\n    std::vector<int> scratch;\n\n    // Recompute the candidate cluster of an owned seed and queue its size\n    auto refresh = [&](const int seed) {\n        ++version[seed];\n        heap.push({grower.grow(seed, scratch), seed, version[seed]});\n    };\n\n    for (int s = rank; s < N; s += size) {\n        refresh(s);\n    }\n\n    int remaining = N;\n    std::vector<int> affected;\n    for (int round = 0; remaining > 0; ++round) {\n        // Best owned seed: discard stale heap entries until the top is current\n        int local[2] = {-1, N};  // {cardinality, seed}\n        while (!heap.empty()) {\n            const SeedEntry top = heap.top();\n            if (!clustered[top.seed] && top.version == version[top.seed]) {\n                local[0] = top.cardinality;\n                local[1] = top.seed;\n                break;\n global[0];\n        const int best_seed = global[1];\n\n        // No cluster can be formed (matches the sequential early exit)\n        if (best_seed < 0 || max_cardinality <= 0) break;\n\n        // Every rank regrows the winning cluster; the result is identical everywhere\n        clusters.emplace_back();\n        Cluster& cluster = clusters.back();\n        cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n        grower.grow(best_seed, cluster.members);\n\n        for (int p : cluster.members) {\n            clustered[p] = 1;\n        }\n        remaining -= static_cast<int>(cluster.members.size());\n\n cluster.members) {\n            grid.forEachNear(points[p], [&](int q) {\n                if (q % size != rank || clustered[q] || stamp[q] == round) return;\n                if (distance(points[q], points[p]) < threshold) {\n                    stamp[q] = round;\n                    affected.push_back(q);\n                }\n            });\n        }\n        for (int q : affected) {\n            refresh(q);\n        }\n    }\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties.\n// Diameters are computed in parallel and all ranks reach the same verdict;\n// only rank 0 prints.\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double Benchmark - Simplified Sequential Version\n// \n// QT (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n    \n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n    \n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n        \n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n        \n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n            \n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n            \n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// Find the closest unclustered point to the current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n// Returns -1 if no such point exists\nint findClosestPoint(const std::vector<int>& cluster_members,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                     const std::vector<bool>& in_cluster,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold,\n                     const int point_count) {\n    int closest_point = -1;\n    double min_diameter = std::numeric_limits<double>::max();\n    \n    // Try each unclustered point as a candidate\n    for (int candidate = 0; candidate < point_count; ++candidate) {\n        // Skip if already clustered or already in this cluster\n        if (clustered[candidate] || in_cluster[candidate]) continue;\n        \n        // Calculate the maximum distance from candidate to all cluster members\n        double max_dist = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = cluster_members[i];\n            const double dist = distance(points[candidate], points[member]);\n            max_dist = std::max(max_dist, dist);\n        }\n        \n        // If adding this point keeps diameter below threshold and is better than current best\n        if (max_dist < threshold && max_dist < min_diameter) {\n            min_diameter = max_dist;\n            closest_point = candidate;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return closest_point;\n}\n\n// Generate a candidate cluster starting from a seed point\n// Returns the cardinality (size) of the cluster\nint generateCandidateCluster(const int seed_point,\n                              const std::vector<bool>& clustered,\n                              const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                              const double threshold,\n                              const int point_count,\n                              std::vector<int>* cluster_members = nullptr) {\n    std::vector<bool> in_cluster(point_count, false);\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    \n    // Add seed point\n    in_cluster[seed_point] = true;\n    members.push_back(seed_point);\n    \n    // Iteratively add closest points\n    while (static_cast<int>(members.size()) < point_count) {\n        // Find closest point to current cluster that maintains diameter < threshold\n        const int closest = findClosestPoint(members, clustered, in_cluster, points, \n                                             threshold, point_count);\n        \n        if (closest < 0) break; // No more points can be added\n        \n        in_cluster[closest] = true;\n        members.push_back(closest);\n    }\n    \n    // Copy members if requested\n    if (cluster_members) {\n        *cluster_members = members;\n    }\n    \n    return static_cast<int>(members.size());\n}\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<bool> clustered(N, false);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    \n    // Initialize unclustered indices\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        unclustered_indices.push_back(i);\n    }\n    \n    // Main clustering loop\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        int max_cardinality = -1;\n        int best_seed = -1;\n        std::vector<int> best_cluster_members;\n        \n        // Try each unclustered point as a seed\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < unclustered_indices.size(); ++i) {\n            const int seed = unclustered_indices[i];\n            if (clustered[seed]) continue;\n            \n            std::vector<int> candidate_members;\n            const int cardinality = generateCandidateCluster(seed, clustered, points, \n                                                       threshold, N, \n                                                       &candidate_members);\n            \n            if (cardinality > max_cardinality) {\n                max_cardinality = cardinality;\n                best_seed = seed;\n                best_cluster_members = candidate_members;\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // If we found a cluster, add it\n        if (best_seed >= 0 && max_cardinality > 0) {\n            Cluster cluster;\n            cluster.seed_point = best_seed;\n            cluster.members = best_cluster_members;\n            clusters.push_back(cluster);\n            \n            // Mark all members as clustered\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < best_cluster_members.size(); ++i) {\n                clustered[best_cluster_members[i]] = true;\n            }\n            \n            // Remove clustered points from unclustered list\n            unclustered_indices.erase(\n                std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                              [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx]; }),\n                unclustered_indices.end()\n            );\n        } else {\n            // No more clusters can be formed\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n    \n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n    \n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        \n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]], \n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        \n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\", \n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n        \n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\", \n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n    \n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int num_points = 1000;\n    double threshold = 2.0;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            num_points = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            threshold = atof(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    if (num_points <= 0 || threshold <= 0.0) {\n        printf(\"Error: Invalid parameters (num_points=%d, threshold=%.2f)\\n\", \n               num_points, threshold);\n        return 1;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"QT Clustering Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Number of points: %d\\n\", num_points);\n    printf(\"Distance threshold: %.2f\\n\", threshold);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Generate synthetic data\n    std::vector<Point> points(num_points);\n    generateSyntheticData(points, num_points);\n    \n    // Perform QT clustering\n    auto cluster_start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    const std::vector<Cluster> clusters = qtClustering(points, threshold);\n    \n    auto cluster_end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto cluster_time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(\n        cluster_end - cluster_start);\n    \n    printf(\"Clustering time: %ld ms\\n\", cluster_time.count());\n    printf(\"Clusters found: %zu\\n\", clusters.size());\n    \n    // Calculate statistics and performance metrics\n    int total_clustered = 0;\n    int max_cluster_size = 0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters.size(); ++i) {\n        const int size = static_cast<int>(clusters[i].members.size());\n        total_clustered += size;\n        max_cluster_size = std::max(max_cluster_size, size);\n    }\n    \n    const double avg_cluster_size = clusters.empty() ? 0.0 : \n        static_cast<double>(total_clustered) / clusters.size();\n    \n    printf(\"Points clustered: %d / %d (%.1f%%)\\n\", \n           total_clustered, num_points, \n           100.0 * total_clustered / num_points);\n    printf(\"Average cluster size: %.2f\\n\", avg_cluster_size);\n    printf(\"Maximum cluster size: %d\\n\", max_cluster_size);\n    \n    // Performance metrics\n    const double time_sec = cluster_time.count() / 1000.0;\n    const double clusters_per_sec = clusters.size() / time_sec;\n    const double points_per_sec = num_points / time_sec;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.1f clusters/s, %.1f points/s\\n\", \n           clusters_per_sec, points_per_sec);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        // Serialize cluster membership for hashing\n        std::vector<double> membershipData;\n        membershipData.reserve(num_points);\n        std::vector<int> membership(num_points, -1);\n        for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n            for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n                membership[clusters[c].members[i]] = static_cast<int>(c);\n            }\n        }\n        for (int m : membership) {\n            membershipData.push_back(static_cast<double>(m));\n        }\n        print_results(membershipData, \"ClusterMembership\");\n    }\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfxeBPRJFZQ21if656mX6","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The clustering benchmark now runs under MPI, and every rank count I tested reproduces the original output exactly. Only `qtclustering/qtclustering.cpp` and `qtclustering/CMakeLists.txt` changed, and the executable name is still `qtclustering`.\n\n**How it's parallelized**\n- Every rank holds the full point set and the cluster state. Seed `s` is evaluated by rank `s % size`.\n- Each round, the ranks pick the global best seed with one `MPI_Allreduce` using `MPI_MAXLOC`. That takes the largest candidate cluster and the lowest seed index on ties, the same choice as the sequential loop. Every rank then regrows that cluster locally, so no member lists are sent.\n- The validation diameter checks are split across ranks too. Only rank 0 prints.\n- MPI is required in CMake (`find_package(MPI REQUIRED)`) and the program always calls `MPI_Init`, so it also runs with `-np 1`.\n\n**Algorithmic changes that keep results identical**\n- A seed's candidate cluster depends only on unclustered points within the threshold of it. Each rank caches those sizes and recomputes only the seeds near newly clustered points.\n- Growth keeps each candidate's max distance to the cluster incrementally and drops candidates that reach the threshold. The old version rescanned every point against every member at each step.\n- A uniform grid limits candidates to points within the threshold.\n\n**Verification**\n- I built the original as a baseline in `/tmp` and compared full stdout, including validation and the `-r` hash, with timing lines excluded. Five parameter sets (N from 60 to 1200, thresholds 0.05 to 25) matched at 1, 2, 5 and 16 ranks, and the earlier sets also matched at 3, 4 and 7 ranks.\n- Scaling for `-n 20000 -t 1.0` was 4120 ms at 1 rank, 2136 ms at 2, 1132 ms at 4 and 638 ms at 8, with the same 631 clusters every time.\n- The build has no warnings under `-Wall -Wextra`.\n\n**Pre-existing issue, not changed**\n- `generateSyntheticData` never terminates for N ≤ 30, because `N / 30.0` is at most 1 and so `group_cnt` is always 0. I left it alone to keep the generated data identical. Anything with `-n` of 30 or less will hang in both versions.\n\nNo git repo here, so nothing was committed. Run it with `mpirun -np <P> ./qtclustering [options]`."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1506,"cache_read_input_tokens":78220,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1506},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"aea26c72-9269-4e76-a41b-46cc8fd8f412","uuid":"7e92b1e6-9f07-4938-b311-d7d750fca6ac","timestamp":"2026-10-12T16:15:46.284Z","request_id":"req_011CfxeBP6CrC4jwM875uTaC"}
